messages:
lee_su (acct:acme): Hey team — since the model bump this week our assistant answers have gotten noticeably shorter and a bit blunt. Not sure if this is intended. We rely on slightly more explanatory, friendly replies for our UX. Example (user prompt + response before vs after):
```
PROMPT: 'How do I set up SSO for our app?'
BEFORE (redwood-3.1): 'You can set up SSO by configuring SAML in the admin console. Go to Settings → Auth → Add provider, fill in the IdP metadata, set the ACS URL to https://app.acme.com/saml/acs, map attributes email and name, then test and enable. Let me know if you want a step-by-step with screenshots.'
AFTER (redwood-3.2): 'Configure SAML in admin Settings. Add provider, enter IdP metadata, set ACS to https://app.acme.com/saml/acs, map attributes, test and enable.'
```
lee_su (acct:acme): The after response removes the offer to help further and drops the friendly 'Let me know' phrasing. It's subtle but customers notice it as colder and less helpful.
olivia (redwood-support): Sorry about that — thanks for the clear repro. When did you first see the change? Do you have the model id and call payload you used?
lee_su (acct:acme): We saw it starting 2026-03-10 around 03:15 UTC. We call the hosted API with model "redwood-3.2" (no system messages, user-only prompts), temperature 0.2, top_p default. Payload snippet: `{"model":"redwood-3.2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"How do I set up SSO for our app?"}],"temperature":0.2}`
olivia (redwood-support): Got it. @samir / @nora can you take a look? Customer included before/after examples and a timestamp. If this is a behavioral delta from the rollout we should triage quickly. :thinking:
deploy-bot: Deployed release redwood-3.2 to hosted-api at 2026-03-10T03:12:08Z (pipeline #249)
samir (eng-ml): Thanks for the ping. Quick questions: 1) Do you have any other prompt examples where verbosity dropped? 2) Did you notice any change in factuality or only tone/length? 3) Is your usage high-volume (could be batching/early-truncate) or single-request interactive?
lee_su (acct:acme): I attached two more short examples in the thread: one about password resets and one about onboarding emails — both show the same pattern: before was slightly more explanatory, after is terser. Factual content looks fine, just less scaffolding and fewer offers to continue. Volume is normal interactive traffic, not heavy batching.
samir (eng-ml): Thanks. We shipped a small behavior normalization change in the response postprocessing for redwood-3.2 to trim trailing verbosity in some system-assisted prompts — it was intended to reduce hallucination risk for instruction chains. That might explain the shorter replies. I don't know offhand whether it would remove offers like 'Let me know if you want more details'.
lee_su (acct:acme): Understood. Any chance to get a quick workaround? Customers are getting confused.
samir (eng-ml): Two options: 1) Pin to the older model variant (redwood-3.1) while we investigate. 2) Add a small system prompt forcing style, e.g. `{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that gives friendly, slightly verbose, helpful answers and always offer next steps."}` — that'll restore tone in most cases. If you want, we can run an automated A/B of the same prompts against 3.1 and 3.2 and produce a diff.
nora (redwood-sre): I'll pull inference logs and request traces for the customer's calls around 2026-03-10T03:12-03:20Z and confirm whether any batching/early-terminate heuristics were applied.
olivia (redwood-support): Lee, would you prefer we pin your account to 3.1 temporarily or try the system prompt workaround? If pinning, we'll open an ops ticket and apply it ASAP.
lee_su (acct:acme): Please pin us to 3.1 for now. We want to avoid changing prompts at the product level while we wait for a fix. Thanks. :thumbsup:
olivia (redwood-support): Copy that — opening ops ticket. @samir I'll assign you to run the compare job and check the postprocessing change. @nora please attach logs when available. I'll follow up with the ticket id shortly.
samir (eng-ml): On it — I'll run batch diffs and grep for the postprocess rule that trims 'follow-up offers'. If it's the cause we can adjust the rule to preserve explicit 'offer more help' phrases.
nora (redwood-sre): Logs pulled and attached to the ops ticket. No evidence of error or truncation; requests look single-shot.
lee_su (acct:acme): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick response. We'll wait for the ops ticket update and the comparison results.
olivia (redwood-support): Ops ticket created: OPR-5421 — pinning acme -> redwood-3.1 done, ETA for engineering investigation 48–72h. Will update the thread with findings. :white_check_mark:
